title: Trump Ends His Child Separation Practice

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于对设计的热爱以及围绕它的文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店打碟的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the Trump administration has signed an executive order ending the separation of parents and children.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普政府签署了一项行政令，结束了父母与子女的分离政策。

sentences.en: So is everything just going back to the way it was?
sentences.zh: 那么，一切都要回到从前的样子了吗？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月21日，星期四。

sentences.en: If I might, I just wanted to make a brief statement on immigration and what's happening.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我想就移民问题和目前的情况发表简短声明。

sentences.en: And I'll say it very honestly and I'll say it very straight.
sentences.zh: 我会非常诚实、非常直白地说出来。

sentences.en: So from the very beginning of this controversy over separating parents and children at the border, President Trump has placed the blame on Democrats.
sentences.zh: 从边境分离父母与子女的争议一开始，特朗普总统就把责任归咎于民主党人。

sentences.en: Immigration is the fault and all of the problems that we're having because we cannot get them to sign legislation.
sentences.zh: 移民问题以及我们遇到的所有问题都是他们的错，因为我们无法让他们签署立法。

sentences.en: We cannot get them even to the negotiating table.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至无法让他们坐到谈判桌前。

sentences.en: And I say it's very strongly the Democrats' fault.
sentences.zh: 我强烈认为这是民主党人的错。

sentences.en: They're obstruction.
sentences.zh: 他们是在阻挠。

sentences.en: They're really obstructioniSt.
sentences.zh: 他们真的是阻挠者。

sentences.en: And they are obstructing.
sentences.zh: 而且他们正在进行阻挠。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: the notion that Democrats would be responsible for a practice that seems like pretty much a Democratic nightmare when it comes to immigration policy doesn't at all seem intuitive.
sentences.zh: 认为民主党人要对一种在移民政策上看起来像是民主党噩梦的做法负责，这听起来一点也不直观。

sentences.en: Is there a case to be made here?
sentences.zh: 这里有站得住脚的理由吗？

sentences.en: What's the basis on which the president is saying that the Democrats caused this?
sentences.zh: 总统说民主党人导致了这一切的依据是什么？

sentences.en: There really isn't a case to be made here,
sentences.zh: 这里根本没有什么站得住脚的理由，

sentences.en: and it's pretty disingenuous on its face because the law the president was invoking in order to force these separations is the most basic one on the books.
sentences.zh: 而且从表面上看这非常虚伪，因为总统为了强制执行这些分离所援引的法律是现行法律中最基础的一条。

sentences.en: It's that you can't enter the country without permission.
sentences.zh: 那就是你不能在未经许可的情况下进入这个国家。

sentences.en: Everybody agrees on that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都同意这一点。

sentences.en: And that law doesn't exist because of the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而且那条法律并不是因为民主党人而存在的。

sentences.en: Caitlin Dickerson covers immigration for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·迪克森为《时报》报道移民问题。

sentences.en: But it is true that a lot of Republicans and the president believe that larger issues with the immigration system are the fault of the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但确实有很多共和党人和总统认为，移民系统中更大的问题是民主党人的错。

sentences.en: He believes he came into office with an immigration system that was totally in disrepair.
sentences.zh: 他认为他上任时，移民系统已经完全失修了。

sentences.en: People requesting asylum in droves, even though the vast number who do aren't eligible for it.
sentences.zh: 人们蜂拥而至申请庇护，尽管其中绝大多数人并不符合条件。

sentences.en: A massive undocumented population that wasn't getting any smaller.
sentences.zh: 庞大的无证人口数量并没有减少。

sentences.en: The courts are backlogged.
sentences.zh: 法院积压严重。

sentences.en: Detention centers are full.
sentences.zh: 拘留中心人满为患。

sentences.en: Borders are overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 边境不堪重负。

sentences.en: So you could make the argument, and I think the president sort of is in a very general way, that he came into a system that was totally broken, that that was the Democrats' fault.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以提出这样的论点，而且我认为总统在很大程度上就是这么认为的，即他接手的是一个完全崩溃的系统，而那是民主党人的错。

sentences.en: And so he had to do something really extreme.
sentences.zh: 所以他不得不采取一些非常极端的措施。

sentences.en: And that extreme move becomes his zero-tolerance policy in which everybody who crosses the border is prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 而那个极端的举动就是他的“零容忍”政策，即所有越境者都会被起诉。

sentences.en: And that means everybody who comes with kids is separated from them.
sentences.zh: 这意味着所有带着孩子来的人都会与孩子分离。

sentences.en: So the president is saying that Democrats caused this by allowing the immigration system to get so bad in the first place.
sentences.zh: 所以总统是在说，民主党人允许移民系统变得如此糟糕，从而导致了这一切。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's also blaming Democrats for the fact that legislative change hasn't coming under his administration.
sentences.zh: 而且他还指责民主党人，称在他的政府领导下未能实现立法变革。

sentences.en: He's pinning that on Democrats as well.
sentences.zh: 他也把这一点归咎于民主党人。

sentences.en: Ultimately, Congress has got to change the law.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，国会必须修改法律。

sentences.en: They've got to change the law.
sentences.zh: 他们必须修改法律。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Mr. President, people say, look, you rip these families apart.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，总统先生，人们说，看，你拆散了这些家庭。

sentences.en: Even though it is the law, it's heartless.
sentences.zh: 即使这是法律，它也是冷酷无情的。

sentences.en: But that's the law.
sentences.zh: 但这就是法律。

sentences.en: And that's what the Democrats gave us.
sentences.zh: 这就是民主党人给我们的。

sentences.en: And we're willing to change it today if they want to get in and negotiate.
sentences.zh: 如果他们愿意参与谈判，我们今天就愿意修改它。

sentences.en: But they just don't want to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 但他们就是不想谈判。

sentences.en: They're afraid of security for our country.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕我们国家的安全。

sentences.en: They're afraid of a wall.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕筑墙。

sentences.en: And is he right in making that argument?
sentences.zh: 他提出这个论点是对的吗？

sentences.en: Was it the action or the inaction of Democrats that led the Trump administration to implement this family separation practice?
sentences.zh: 是民主党人的行动还是不作为导致特朗普政府实施了这种家庭分离做法？

sentences.en: I don't think that you can argue it is.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你可以这样说。

sentences.en: I mean, when it comes to the legislative frustration and the lack of action under this administration,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当谈到立法上的挫败感和本届政府缺乏行动时，

sentences.en: both sides have really held that debate hostage with various sort of extreme policies that they've been unwilling to yield on that are deal breakers for the other side.
sentences.zh: 双方确实都用各种不愿让步的极端政策绑架了辩论，这些政策对另一方来说都是不可接受的。

sentences.en: It was a week filled with possibility.
sentences.zh: 那是一个充满可能性的星期。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Senate debating a fix for young immigrants brought to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 参议院正在辩论一项针对被父母非法带入美国的年轻移民的解决方案，并着手进行移民改革。

sentences.en: illegally as children by their parents and taking up immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 我们本周有机会把它做好。

sentences.en: We have a chance this week to get it right.
sentences.zh: 最终，参议院否决了两党计划和总统提出的计划。

sentences.en: In the end, the Senate rejected both a bipartisan plan and one proposed by the president.
sentences.zh: 我以为我们对面的朋友会抓住这个机会，去实现他们所说的首要任务。

sentences.en: I thought our friends across the aisle would jump at this opportunity to fulfill what they say is their top priority.
sentences.zh: 但他们就是无法接受这个结果。

sentences.en: But they just couldn't take yes for an answer.
sentences.zh: 当谈到关于家庭分离的这个更大的问题，以及特朗普是否因为民主党人的行动或不作为而不得不采取这些手段时，

sentences.en: When it comes to this bigger question about family separations and whether Trump had to resort to those as a result of Democratic action or inaction,
sentences.zh: 我认为事实是，在过去几届政府中，如何降低越境人数这个问题一直无法解决。

sentences.en: I think what's true is that for several administrations past, you know, this question of how to lower the number of border crossers has been unanswerable.
sentences.zh: 没有人能想出办法，包括奥巴马总统。

sentences.en: Nobody's been able to figure it out, including President Obama.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普采取的开始分离家庭的行动，是我们迄今为止看到的最极端的举动。

sentences.en: And so this action that Trump takes to start separating families, it's the most extreme move that we've seen yet.
sentences.zh: 这是为了试图回答一个问题，诚然，奥巴马总统无法想出答案，但之前的任何政府也都没能做到。

sentences.en: And it's to try to answer a question that, true, President Obama couldn't figure out how to answer, but no previous administration was able to before it.
sentences.zh: 困境在于，如果你软弱，如果你软弱——有些人希望你软弱——如果你真的、真的非常软弱，

sentences.en: The dilemma is that if you're weak, if you're weak, which some people would like you to be, if you're really, really pathetically weak,
sentences.zh: 这个国家就会被数百万人淹没。

sentences.en: the country is going to be overrun with millions of people.
sentences.zh: 而如果你强硬，那你就是铁石心肠。

sentences.en: And if you're strong, then you don't have any heart.
sentences.zh: 这是一个艰难的困境。

sentences.en: That's a tough dilemma.
sentences.zh: 也许我宁愿强硬。

sentences.en: Perhaps I'd rather be strong.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府初期，边境人数确实自行大幅下降了。

sentences.en: And in the beginning of the Trump administration, the border numbers kind of dropped on their own really dramatically.
sentences.zh: 共和党人认为这个问题仅凭总统的强硬言论就能自行解决。

sentences.en: Republicans thought that this problem would solve itself just from the president's tough talk.
sentences.zh: 但果不其然，它们又回到了选举前的水平。

sentences.en: But sure enough, they came back to pre-election levels.
sentences.zh: 因此，最近总统解决这个问题的压力更大了。

sentences.en: And so the pressure has been even higher on the president to figure out that problem recently.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普政府面临着与过去政府（包括奥巴马政府）相同的问题，

sentences.en: So the Trump administration has the same problem as past administrations, including the Obama administration,
sentences.zh: 但从他们的角度来看，由于特朗普的纲领和言论，风险更高了。

sentences.en: but with greater stakes from their perspective because of the Trump platform and rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，之前没有任何政府愿意诉诸这种特定的做法。

sentences.en: And the difference is that none of these previous administrations have been willing to resort to this particular practice.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普政府是否从这种做法开始的那一刻起就一直试图将责任归咎于民主党人？

sentences.en: So has the Trump administration been trying to blame Democrats for this practice from the moment that the practice began?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They have.
sentences.zh: 而且他们实际上在最开始就更进一步，甚至在几个月的时间里否认他们正在分离家庭，

sentences.en: And they actually, they went a step further in the very beginning and for months actually denied that they were separating families at all
sentences.zh: 直到我们获得了显示他们确实在这样做的证据。

sentences.en: until we got access to data that showed they were.
sentences.zh: 所以这让你对我们从一开始就看到的烟雾弹程度有了一个了解，迈克尔，

sentences.en: And so that kind of gives you an indication, Michael, of the level of smoke and mirrors that we've seen from the beginning,
sentences.zh: 在关于家庭分离的对话中，这是一种语义上的混淆和遮掩。

sentences.en: sort of semantics and obfuscation in this conversation about family separation.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们已经非常清楚地表明，民主党人在国会与他们修改法律的能力之间存在差距。

sentences.en: I think we've made it abundantly clear that the daylight exists between Democrats and Congress and their ability to change this law.
sentences.zh: 总统本人也说过，他讨厌这些画面，他讨厌这个过程。

sentences.en: The president himself said that he doesn't, he hates these images, he hates this process.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他要求解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And that's why he's asked for it to be fixed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一旦政府基本上被揭穿，全国都知道他们在分离家庭时，

sentences.en: You know, once the administration was essentially busted and the country figured out they were separating families,
sentences.zh: 就出现了这种论点，即这是民主党人的错，因为他们不愿意修改现行的移民法。

sentences.en: then came this argument that this is the Democrats' fault because they weren't willing to change existing immigration law.
sentences.zh: 所以本届政府别无选择，只能执行它。

sentences.en: And so this administration had no choice but to enforce it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们一直在忽视一个事实，即总统不是法律的制定者，制定法律是国会的工作。

sentences.en: I feel like we keep ignoring the fact that the president isn't the one that creates the law, but it's Congress's job to create the law.
sentences.zh: 总统已经多次公开表示，他很乐意签署能够修复这些漏洞并完善我们移民系统的立法。

sentences.en: And the president's already laid out and gladly stated a number of times publicly that he would sign legislation that fixes these loopholes and fixes our immigration system.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个论点完全站不住脚的地方，因为国会与分离父母和子女的决定毫无关系。

sentences.en: And that's where this argument totally falls apart, because Congress doesn't have anything to do with the decision to separate parents and children.
sentences.zh: 国会在分离家庭的决定中没有发挥任何作用，在周三改变这一做法的决定中也没有发挥作用。

sentences.en: Congress didn't play any role in the decision to separate families and then the decision on Wednesday to change that practice.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们应该去恳求并敲开国会的大门，要求他们与总统合作，而不是与他对抗，

sentences.en: I think that people should be begging and banging down the doors of Congress and asking them to join with the president instead of fighting him,
sentences.zh: 而不是不断地批评，为什么他们不提供解决方案？

sentences.en: instead of constantly criticizing, why aren't they offering solutions?
sentences.zh: 你有像南希·佩洛西和查克·舒默这样的人出来抱怨和攻击。

sentences.en: You have people like Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer who come out and complain and attack.
sentences.zh: 这是因为他们没有信息。

sentences.en: It's because they have no message.
sentences.zh: 他们没有解决方案。

sentences.en: They have no solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们已经提出了一个解决方案，我们希望看到他们与我们合作将其付诸实施。

sentences.en: We've laid out a solution, and we'd like to see them work with us to put it in place.
sentences.zh: 国会是如何回应总统试图将分离政策归咎于他们的行为的？

sentences.en: And how is Congress responding to the president's attempts to blame it for the separation policy?
sentences.zh: 所以国会中的共和党人和民主党人都说，停止分离父母和子女吧，停止这样做完全在白宫的能力范围之内。

sentences.en: So both Republicans and Democrats in Congress have said, just stop separating parents and children, that it falls squarely within the abilities of the White House to stop doing it.
sentences.zh: 他们确实指出了白宫在过去几周里试图采取的一种鬼鬼祟祟的举动，

sentences.en: And they really called the White House out on a kind of sneaky move that it's been trying to make in the last few weeks,
sentences.zh: 总统和国土安全部长都公开且非常大声地坚称，根本不存在家庭分离政策。

sentences.en: where both the president and the Homeland Security Secretary have insisted publicly and really loudly that there is no family separation policy.
sentences.zh: 你打算让事情就这样发展下去吗？

sentences.en: Are you intending for this to play out as it is playing out?
sentences.zh: 你打算让父母与子女分离吗？

sentences.en: Are you intending for parents to be separated from their children?
sentences.zh: 你打算传递一个信息吗？

sentences.en: Are you intending to send a message?
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很冒犯人。

sentences.en: I find that offensive.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 因为我为什么要制定一个故意这样做的政策呢？

sentences.en: Because why would I ever create a policy that purposely does that?
sentences.zh: 也许这是一种威慑。

sentences.en: Perhaps it's a deterrence.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在重复那句话。

sentences.en: They kept repeating that line.
sentences.zh: 关于国土安全部在边境对家庭所做和未做的事情，有很多错误信息。

sentences.en: There's a lot of misinformation about what DHS is and is not doing as it relates to families at the border.
sentences.zh: 我想澄清事实。

sentences.en: And I want to correct the record.
sentences.zh: 以下是事实。

sentences.en: Here are the facts.
sentences.zh: 首先，本届政府并没有制定在边境分离家庭的政策。

sentences.en: First, this administration did not create a policy of separating families at the border.
sentences.zh: 有没有家庭分离政策并不重要，因为父母和孩子确实正在被分离。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter if there's a family separation policy or not, because parents and children were being separated.
sentences.zh: 我认为公众和国会都揭穿了白宫，并说，

sentences.en: And I think both the public and Congress kind of called the White House out and said,
sentences.zh: 看，我们知道你们想做什么，但归根结底，你们仍然在把人分开。

sentences.en: look, we see what you're trying to do, but at the end of the day, you're still separating people from one another.
sentences.zh: 我支持，共和党会议的所有成员也都支持一项在确定移民身份期间让家庭保持团聚的计划。

sentences.en: I support and all of the members of the Republican conference support a plan that keeps families together while their immigration status is determined.
sentences.zh: 国会说，你知道，停下来吧。

sentences.en: Congress said, you know, just stop it.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到我们之前进行的争论中去。

sentences.en: Let's go back to the arguments that we were having before.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到试图提出立法解决方案上来。

sentences.en: Let's go back to trying to come up with legislative fixes.
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，让我们让父母和孩子在一起。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, let's keep parents and kids together.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，只有你能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Mr. President, you alone can fix it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，总统只需动动笔，签署一项总统令，

sentences.en: In fact, the president alone can fix it with this flick of a pen by signing a presidential order
sentences.zh: 就能结束那些与父母分离的小孩痛苦的哭喊声。

sentences.en: to end the agonizing screams of small children who have been separated from their parents.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我把我的笔借给你。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I'll lend you my pen.
sentences.zh: 任何笔都行。

sentences.en: Any pen.
sentences.zh: 你可以自己解决它。

sentences.en: You can fix it yourself.
sentences.zh: 我们正在签署一项我认为非常重要的行政令。

sentences.en: We're signing an executive order I consider to be a very important executive order.
sentences.zh: 它是关于让家庭保持团聚，同时确保我们拥有一个非常强大、

sentences.en: It's about keeping families together while at the same time being sure that we have a very powerful,
sentences.zh: 非常稳固的边境，边境安全将与以前持平，甚至更强。

sentences.en: very strong border and border security will be equal, if not greater, than previously.
sentences.zh: 看来国会在周三的辩论中占了上风。

sentences.en: And it seems like Congress has prevailed in that argument on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，因为特朗普总统宣布了一项行政令，父母和孩子将保持团聚。

sentences.en: It does, because President Trump announced an executive order in which parents and kids are going to be kept together.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将拥有强大、非常强大的边境，但我们会让家庭保持团聚。

sentences.en: So we're going to have strong, very strong borders, but we're going to keep the families together.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢看到或感觉到家庭被拆散。

sentences.en: I didn't like the sight or the feeling of families being separated.
sentences.zh: 那么在这样做的时候，国会是否表明总统的论点相当空洞？

sentences.en: And in doing so, did Congress show that the president's arguments were pretty hollow?
sentences.zh: 因为事实上是总统利用他的行政权力采取行动结束了这一切，而国会什么也没做。

sentences.en: Because it was in fact the president, using his executive authority, who acted to end this, and Congress did nothing.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以这么说。

sentences.en: I think you could say that.
sentences.zh: 我想，是的，最终总统不得不采取行动来改变它。

sentences.en: I think, yes, ultimately the president had to act to change it.
sentences.zh: 这使得这项政策从一开始就完全回到了他身上。

sentences.en: And that puts this policy squarely back on him right from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这使得这项政策从一开始就完全回到了他身上。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Congress was right in saying, you can fix this on your own.
sentences.zh: 国会说得对，你们完全可以自己解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Your argument that this is a legislative matter clearly is wrong, because you just fixed it.
sentences.zh: 你之前辩称这是一个立法问题，显然是错的，因为你刚刚就把它解决了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So, after days of insisting that he can't fix it, that it's really up to Congress, why do you think that Trump caved on this and acted on his own?
sentences.zh: 那么，在坚持了几天说他无法解决、这真的取决于国会之后，你认为特朗普为什么会在这件事上妥协并采取行动？

sentences.en: I think the administration has faced, in the last couple of weeks, a level of pressure and criticism from the media,
sentences.zh: 我认为在过去几周里，本届政府面临着来自媒体、

sentences.en: from its supporters, from Republicans, from Democrats, from Congress, that is really, I think, unmatched under this administration.
sentences.zh: 来自其支持者、共和党人、民主党人以及国会的压力和批评，我认为这在本届政府执政期间是前所未有的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's as if the entire country was looking at the White House and saying, why are you doing this?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就好像整个国家都在注视着白宫，质问他们为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: You know, the entire country is looking at photos and videos and hearing audio of children being separated from their parents.
sentences.zh: 你知道，全国上下都在看着照片和视频，听着孩子们与父母分离的录音。

sentences.en: And it was just a red line for so many people that I think the president really felt like he had no choice.
sentences.zh: 这对很多人来说是一条底线，所以我认为总统真的觉得他别无选择。

sentences.en: So, how exactly does he end this thing?
sentences.zh: 那么，他到底打算如何结束这件事呢？

sentences.en: So, he introduces an executive order that says, we're still going to prosecute everybody with zero tolerance,
sentences.zh: 他颁布了一项行政命令，称我们将继续对所有人实行“零容忍”政策，

sentences.en: but we're going to make sure that parents and children are kept together.
sentences.zh: 但我们要确保父母和孩子能够待在一起。

sentences.en: So, that means we're going to sort of reinvigorate the family detention facilities that already exiSt.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们将重新启用现有的家庭拘留设施。

sentences.en: And we're also going to call on the military to try to very quickly construct more and any other federal agency that can help to contribute to make sure there's enough room
sentences.zh: 我们还将要求军方尽快建造更多设施，并要求任何其他能够提供帮助的联邦机构共同努力，确保有足够的空间

sentences.en: to hold people in custody while also keeping them together.
sentences.zh: 在将人们拘留的同时，也能让他们待在一起。

sentences.en: But was that even the issue?
sentences.zh: 但这真的是问题的关键吗？

sentences.en: Isn't the entire premise of zero tolerance that everyone crossing the border will face criminal prosecution?
sentences.zh: “零容忍”政策的前提难道不是所有越境者都将面临刑事起诉吗？

sentences.en: And because of that, children have to be separated from their parents because minors can't be included in that process.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，孩子们必须与父母分离，因为未成年人无法被纳入该程序。

sentences.en: So, how is it possible to simultaneously maintain zero tolerance but keep families together?
sentences.zh: 那么，如何在维持“零容忍”的同时又让家庭待在一起呢？

sentences.en: That was the argument and a lot of this comes down to looking at policies on the books
sentences.zh: 这就是之前的论点，而这很大程度上归结于审视现行政策，

sentences.en: and then realizing that administrations have incredible power in terms of how they want to interpret them.
sentences.zh: 并意识到政府在如何解读这些政策方面拥有巨大的权力。

sentences.en: So, in the past, when somebody was prosecuted criminally, they were automatically separated from their child because you don't send a kid to jail.
sentences.zh: 所以，过去当有人被刑事起诉时，他们会自动与孩子分离，因为你不能把孩子送进监狱。

sentences.en: But under President Obama, very, very few people were prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 但在奥巴马总统任内，被起诉的人非常非常少。

sentences.en: Okay, and now that we're in a position where far more people are going to be prosecuted, we come up against this court settlement from 1997.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我们面临的情况是，会有更多的人被起诉，于是我们遇到了1997年的一项法院和解协议。

sentences.en: It's called the Flores Settlement.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“弗洛雷斯和解协议”（Flores Settlement）。

sentences.en: And that has limited the ability of administrations to hold children in custody for more than 20 days.
sentences.zh: 该协议限制了政府将儿童拘留超过20天的能力。

sentences.en: So, in the past, when you would see parents and children held in custody together, they could only stay in for 20 days and then they would have to be released.
sentences.zh: 所以，过去当你看到父母和孩子被一起拘留时，他们只能待20天，然后就必须被释放。

sentences.en: Well, that's not going to work for President Trump because we know he hates this idea of catch and release and so do his supporters.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这对特朗普总统来说行不通，因为我们知道他讨厌“抓了就放”的做法，他的支持者也一样。

sentences.en: So, he's figured out a way to keep parents and children together but to make sure they stay in custody until their cases are adjudicated
sentences.zh: 所以，他想出了一个办法，既能让父母和孩子待在一起，又能确保他们在案件审理期间一直被拘留，

sentences.en: and, you know, as he hopes, until most of them are deported.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如他所希望的那样，直到他们中的大多数人被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: By eliminating this 1997 rule that said children can't be held for longer than 20 days.
sentences.zh: 通过废除那条规定儿童拘留不得超过20天的1997年规则。

sentences.en: That's what he's trying to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是他试图做的事情。

sentences.en: By trying to supersede that ruling with coming up with an executive order that really contradicts what it says.
sentences.zh: 他试图通过颁布一项与该裁决相矛盾的行政命令来取代它。

sentences.en: So, the ruling says you can't keep people in custody for more than 20 days but the executive order says you can keep people in custody indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 裁决说不能拘留超过20天，但行政命令却说可以无限期拘留。

sentences.en: And why didn't President Obama just do the same thing then?
sentences.zh: 那为什么奥巴马总统当时不直接这样做呢？

sentences.en: Try to supersede this 1997 ruling?
sentences.zh: 尝试取代这个1997年的裁决？

sentences.en: Well, because you can't just supersede court rulings and that's why this is very likely going to result in a very big legal battle
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为你不能随随便便就取代法院的裁决，这就是为什么这很可能会导致一场巨大的法律战，

sentences.en: because Flores has been caught up in the court since 1997 and we're still seeing appeals and decisions come down on that case today.
sentences.zh: 因为“弗洛雷斯”案自1997年以来一直纠缠在法庭上，直到今天我们仍能看到针对该案的上诉和裁决。

sentences.en: So, to sort of come out of nowhere and introduce an executive order that contradicts it is an approach.
sentences.zh: 所以，突然冒出来颁布一项与之相矛盾的行政命令，这是一种策略。

sentences.en: That's what the Trump administration is trying to do but you can expect that lawyers are going to challenge it.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普政府试图做的事情，但你可以预见律师们会对此提出挑战。

sentences.en: So, this executive order, eliminating the separation practice but maintaining zero tolerance, is unlikely to hold up in court.
sentences.zh: 因此，这项废除分离做法但维持“零容忍”的行政命令，不太可能在法庭上站得住脚。

sentences.en: You could very easily see a scenario where the policy falls apart in court and where we end up exactly where we were before family separation
sentences.zh: 你很容易预见到这样一种情况：该政策在法庭上破产，而我们最终回到了家庭分离政策实施前的原点，

sentences.en: which is parents and children who cross the border together are detained for 20 days and then they're released until their cases are adjudicated.
sentences.zh: 也就是一起越境的父母和孩子被拘留20天，然后被释放，直到他们的案件得到审理。

sentences.en: So, this is exactly why other administrations have found themselves in the impossible situation that the Trump administration finds itself in.
sentences.zh: 所以，这正是为什么其他政府会发现自己陷入了特朗普政府目前所处的这种不可能的境地。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's incredibly difficult to come up with a policy that effectively discourages people from coming to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，要制定出一项既能有效阻止人们来美国、

sentences.en: that lowers in a meaningful way the number of people who are coming here but that doesn't violate their rights.
sentences.zh: 又能以有意义的方式减少来美人数，同时又不侵犯他们权利的政策，是极其困难的。

sentences.en: And that's why, you know, administration after administration continues to throw spaghetti against the wall and nothing sticks.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么一届又一届的政府不断地尝试各种方法，却始终没有奏效。

sentences.en: So, in that sense, is the president in effect right that only Congress can really solve the immigration problems?
sentences.zh: 那么从这个意义上说，总统认为只有国会才能真正解决移民问题，这在实际上是对的吗？

sentences.en: You could look at it that way.
sentences.zh: 你可以这样看。

sentences.en: I mean, you could, again, say that you have to really step back and you have to really start over from the very beginning to come up with a change.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以再次说，你必须真正退后一步，从头开始，才能做出改变。

sentences.en: You know, it's really hard to speculate about what's going to change the numbers of people crossing the border in a meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很难推测什么能以有意义的方式改变越境人数。

sentences.en: But you could argue that, yeah, administrations have tried just about everything at this point and now it should fall on Congress.
sentences.zh: 但你可以说，是的，政府到目前为止几乎尝试了一切，现在应该轮到国会了。

sentences.en: So, in the meantime, in all likelihood, are we going right back to where we started before the Trump administration began separating children
sentences.zh: 那么在此期间，我们很可能会回到特朗普政府几个月前开始在边境将儿童

sentences.en: from their parents at the border a few months ago?
sentences.zh: 与父母分离之前的状态吗？

sentences.en: Yes and no.
sentences.zh: 既是，也不是。

sentences.en: I mean, we are going back to where we were earlier in the sense that parents and children are going to be held together in custody.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们回到了之前的状态，即父母和孩子将被一起拘留。

sentences.en: The difference is that until this executive order is challenged, they'll be held in custody indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，在这一行政命令受到挑战之前，他们将被无限期拘留。

sentences.en: And on top of that, we still have thousands of children in custody right now who've been separated from their parents and have to figure out what we're going to do with them.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们现在仍有数千名与父母分离的儿童被拘留，我们必须弄清楚该拿他们怎么办。

sentences.en: I mean, as we've reported, these agencies have really struggled to bring people back together.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如我们所报道的那样，这些机构在让人们团聚的问题上确实挣扎不已。

sentences.en: And that's a result of the fact that this separation started happening so quickly and also that it wasn't announced or referred to as a policy.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这种分离发生得太快，而且它并没有被宣布或作为一项政策来执行。

sentences.en: And that means that a lot of the planning and groundwork that comes with a legitimate policy change didn't happen here.
sentences.zh: 这意味着合法政策变更所应有的许多规划和基础工作在这里并没有发生。

sentences.en: So we've seen both the Department of Homeland Security that's holding onto the parents and then the Health and Human Services Department that's holding onto the children
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到，负责拘留父母的国土安全部和负责拘留儿童的卫生与公众服务部，

sentences.en: really fumbled to try to connect the two with one another.
sentences.zh: 在试图将两者联系起来时确实手忙脚乱。

sentences.en: And so we still have these 2,000 at least kids in custody just from recent months who've been separated from parents and we have to figure out how to reunite them.
sentences.zh: 所以我们仍然有至少2000名最近几个月内与父母分离的孩子被拘留，我们必须想办法让他们团聚。

sentences.en: So it's true that this wasn't really a policy.
sentences.zh: 所以说这并不是一项真正的政策，确实如此。

sentences.en: And the impact of that on these children is a very real one.
sentences.zh: 而这对这些孩子的影响是非常真实的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, sort of regardless of whether a document was ever signed by the president that said the United States is, from now on, going to separate parents and children.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论总统是否签署过一份文件说美国从现在起要将父母和孩子分开，

sentences.en: The reality is that it happened to a lot of people and that it's going to continue to affect these kids for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 事实是它发生在了很多人身上，而且它将在很长一段时间内继续影响这些孩子。

sentences.en: There's a problem that's gone on for many years, as you know, for many administrations.
sentences.zh: 正如你所知，这是一个困扰了多年、困扰了多届政府的问题。

sentences.en: And we're working very hard on immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们正在非常努力地处理移民问题。

sentences.en: It's been just left out in the call.
sentences.zh: 它一直被搁置在一旁。

sentences.en: People haven't dealt with it.
sentences.zh: 人们一直没有处理它。

sentences.en: Caitlin, I was struck that even in announcing this executive order on Wednesday, the president's decision to deal with this on his own,
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，让我印象深刻的是，即使在周三宣布这项行政命令时，总统决定独自处理这件事，

sentences.en: President Trump still blames the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统仍然在指责民主党人。

sentences.en: It seems as if he's trying to frame this, even now, as Democrats caused this terrible problem and I'm just fixing it.
sentences.zh: 看起来他即使在现在也试图将其定性为：是民主党人造成了这个可怕的问题，而我只是在解决它。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Even in finally conceding on Wednesday, the president is still placing the blame for this practice and for these broader issues with the immigration system right on the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 即使在周三最终做出让步时，总统仍然将这种做法以及移民系统更广泛问题的责任直接归咎于民主党人。

sentences.en: People haven't dealt with it and we are dealing with it.
sentences.zh: 人们没有处理它，而我们正在处理它。

sentences.en: So step by step, just like we dealt with North Korea, we dealt with Iran, we dealt with an economy that was heading in the wrong direction,
sentences.zh: 所以一步一步来，就像我们处理朝鲜问题、处理伊朗问题、处理正朝着错误方向发展的经济一样，

sentences.en: we dealt with a lot of different probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们处理了许多不同的问题。

sentences.en: This is one that has been gone on for many decades.
sentences.zh: 这是一个已经持续了几十年的问题。

sentences.en: So we're keeping families together and this will solve that problem.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在让家庭团聚，这将解决那个问题。

sentences.en: At the same time, we are keeping a very powerful border and it continues to be a zero tolerance.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们保持着非常强大的边境，并且继续实行“零容忍”。

sentences.en: We have zero tolerance for people that enter our country illegally.
sentences.zh: 我们对非法进入我国的人实行“零容忍”。

sentences.en: With that, I'd ask Mike Pence, vice president,
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想请教副总统迈克·彭斯，

sentences.en: Caitlin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: President Trump's executive order is titled, quote,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的行政命令标题是，引用如下：

sentences.en: Affording Congress an Opportunity to Address Family Separation, suggesting that it is still up to Congress to end the practice of separating children from their parents.
sentences.zh: “给予国会解决家庭分离问题的机会”，暗示结束将儿童与父母分离的做法仍然取决于国会。

sentences.en: It is unfortunate, the order says, that Congress's failure to act and court orders have put the administration in the position of separating alien families
sentences.zh: 该命令称，遗憾的是，国会未能采取行动，加上法院的命令，使政府处于不得不分离外籍家庭

sentences.en: to effectively enforce the law.
sentences.zh: 以有效执行法律的境地。

sentences.en: The House is expected to vote on a bill that would end family separations later today.
sentences.zh: 众议院预计将于今天晚些时候对一项旨在结束家庭分离的法案进行投票。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些未经修饰、未经删减的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com进行部分采访的直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, three major U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三，三家主要的美国

sentences.en: airlines,
sentences.zh: 航空公司，

sentences.en: United, American, and Frontier, said they would refuse to fly immigrant children separated from their parents on behalf of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 美联航、美国航空和边疆航空表示，他们将拒绝代表联邦政府运送与父母分离的移民儿童。

sentences.en: All three airlines said they objected to the Trump administration's practice.
sentences.zh: 这三家航空公司都表示反对特朗普政府的做法。

sentences.en: In a statement, American said, quote,
sentences.zh: 美国航空在一份声明中称，引用如下：

sentences.en: We have no desire to be associated with separating families, or, worse, to profit from it.
sentences.zh: “我们无意与家庭分离扯上关系，更不想从中获利。”

sentences.en: We bring families together, not apart.
sentences.zh: “我们致力于让家庭团聚，而不是拆散他们。”

sentences.en: In response, a spokesman for the Department of Homeland Security accused the airlines of, quote, buckling to a false media narrative.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，国土安全部的一位发言人指责这些航空公司，引用如下：“屈服于虚假的媒体叙事”。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全遮光的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
